bpmn:process.name: Accidental Fulfillment Status Reversal
bpmn:process.bpmn:documentation: Basis: user-approved SRS additions supplied in this conversation: FR-FUL-28-33 (including simplified FR-FUL-31), FR-INV-24-25; existing FR-FUL-27, FR-ANL-05,25, FR-INV-09,17. These additions are treated as the revised specification per user instruction even if not yet present in the local paper. Other sources: docs/proposed-bpmn-catalog.md and Chapters/Kitchen406 - Capstone Paper.md; index.html loads app/fulfillment-state.js F.previous/F.revert, app/owner.js confirmation modal, app/subscription-state.js B.sync and app/earnings-allocation.js. Scope now covers all three authorized one-step reversals. Stock reversal corrects an accidentally recorded preparation start; it is not spoilage recovery or physical restoration of genuinely used materials. FR-FUL-31 requires all changes together, so branch tasks stage their effects and only the shared atomic Commit persists them. No BPMN transaction subprocess is used: there is no long-running transaction/compensation protocol. Two internal responsibility lanes in one pool; no external messages. BPMN-17 owns later preparation; BPMN-18/20/21 own later actual completion; BPMN-05 owns subsequent completion-driven subscription progress; BPMN-43 owns report generation. Those processes are referenced, not called during correction. No authentication, allocation editing, checkout, payment, inventory-adjustment or reporting process is invoked. Existing saved allocations are preserved; automatic unlocking is not specified. Descriptive non-executable BPMN 2.0.

bpmn:lane.name: Kitchen406 System - Fulfillment, inventory and reporting consistency

bpmn:startEvent.name: Accidental status correction requested
bpmn:startEvent.bpmn:documentation: Input: paid operational fulfillment, acting account, current version and unique correction identifier. Authentication is an upstream precondition (BPMN-30).

bpmn:userTask.name: Request reversal of accidental status change
bpmn:userTask.bpmn:documentation: FR-FUL-28. An authorized Owner or Staff requests one permitted previous status.

bpmn:businessRuleTask.name: Check permission, latest status, version and courier restrictions
bpmn:businessRuleTask.bpmn:documentation: FR-FUL-28,30-31. Only paid operational fulfillments: Preparing to Confirmed, Ready to Preparing, Completed to Ready. Reject pending, booked, in-transit, delivered or unresolved courier bookings. Failed/cancelled bookings do not alone prevent correction. Validate current version and operation identifier. Previously processed correction returns its recorded result without new effects.

bpmn:exclusiveGateway.name: Eligible new correction?
bpmn:exclusiveGateway.bpmn:documentation: Unauthorized, ineligible, stale or already-applied requests do not enter the mutation path.

bpmn:serviceTask.name: Display target status and applicable reversal effects
bpmn:serviceTask.bpmn:documentation: FR-FUL-29. Preparing to Confirmed: recorded consumption will be reversed and the ingredients retained as reserved stock. Ready to Preparing: consumption unchanged. Completed to Ready: completion cleared from active state, Fulfilled sales excluded and subscription progress updated as applicable.

bpmn:userTask.name: Review effects and confirm reversal
bpmn:userTask.bpmn:documentation: FR-FUL-29. Explicit confirmation is required. The system-recorded reason is Accidental status correction; no mandatory free-text reason is introduced.

bpmn:endEvent.name: Cancelled; records unchanged
bpmn:endEvent.bpmn:documentation: No reversal or inventory movement is saved.

bpmn:exclusiveGateway.name: Which current status?
bpmn:exclusiveGateway.bpmn:documentation: Use the validated source state. Concurrent changes are checked again at the final atomic commit.

bpmn:serviceTask.name: Stage Preparing to Confirmed and consumption reversal
bpmn:serviceTask.bpmn:documentation: FR-INV-24-25. Prepare the original consumption quantities and reversal-movement links for this fulfillment. Restore recorded physical stock and return the existing reservation to confirmed/unconsumed; quantities remain reserved for this fulfillment, not available to other orders. Preserve original consumption history. This task stages changes only; all effects persist together in Commit. A later preparation start consumes the restored reservation once.

bpmn:serviceTask.name: Stage Ready to Preparing; retain ingredient consumption
bpmn:serviceTask.bpmn:documentation: FR-FUL-28; FR-INV-25. Stage only the status change. Do not restore stock or change the consumed reservation. No staged effect persists before Commit.

bpmn:serviceTask.name: Stage Completed to Ready and completion reversal
bpmn:serviceTask.bpmn:documentation: FR-FUL-27; FR-ANL-05,25; FR-INV-25. Stage status Ready and removal of the old active completion timestamp; preserve the prior timestamp in history. Incomplete fulfillments contribute no Fulfilled sales. No payment reversal, new transaction, stock restoration or report-generation invocation. No substitute date is used. All effects are saved only in Commit.

bpmn:exclusiveGateway.bpmn:documentation: Exactly one correction branch joins here.

bpmn:serviceTask.name: Recheck and save reversal, related changes and audit together
bpmn:serviceTask.bpmn:documentation: FR-FUL-31-33; FR-INV-24-25. Recheck permission, current source status, version and courier restrictions, and process the unique correction once. Atomically commit the staged status and any inventory movement/reservation or active completion change with the audit entry (fulfillment, prior/new statuses, actor, system-recorded reason, time, original completion details and inventory references). Synchronize a linked subscription status and recalculate distinct completed/remaining counts; keep its cycle Active while any of four fulfillments is incomplete. Preserve payment, schedule, original apportioned product amounts and saved allocations. Do not invent allocation-unlocking behavior. On conflict or failure roll back all effects. Restored stock remains reserved. Repeated saves never duplicate stock restoration, audit entries or completion/report effects.

bpmn:exclusiveGateway.name: All changes saved?
bpmn:exclusiveGateway.bpmn:documentation: No partial success: a failed save or final validation conflict preserves the prior records.

bpmn:serviceTask.name: Return reason or previously recorded correction result
bpmn:serviceTask.bpmn:documentation: For unauthorized/ineligible/stale requests or save failure return the reason; no new changes are saved. For a repeated operation return the existing result without another reversal. Review current records before a new attempt. Staff receive operational information only.

bpmn:endEvent.name: No new changes saved
bpmn:endEvent.bpmn:documentation: Saved records remain unchanged by this request; a duplicate may refer to an earlier successful correction.

bpmn:serviceTask.name: Return corrected status and retain audit history
bpmn:serviceTask.bpmn:documentation: The fulfillment is incomplete: Confirmed, Preparing or Ready. Current-state reporting excludes it from Fulfilled sales; verified payments remain on their existing reporting basis. No financial access is granted to Staff.

bpmn:endEvent.name: Accidental correction saved
bpmn:endEvent.bpmn:documentation: Normal preparation or actual completion resumes only on its own later trigger.

bpmn:textAnnotation.bpmn:text: Later actions use their existing processes: Refer to BPMN-17 - Fulfillment Preparation and Ready Confirmation (consume a restored reservation once). Actual completion: BPMN-18 - Standard Order and Subscription Pickup and Completion; BPMN-20 - Courier Delivery Status Tracking and Completion; BPMN-21 - Owner-Managed Cake Delivery and Handoff. After a reversed completion, record a NEW timestamp and include the fulfillment ONCE. BPMN-05 handles subsequent subscription completion progress; BPMN-43 owns report generation. These are later handoffs, not automatic calls from reversal.
